answer: Before an agent may attest, it must open three live counterpart-escrows with peers whose first-seen funding paths have not overlapped for twelve epochs. Each escrow locks a ferrous bond against that pair. If spend-timing across an ocean of keys implies shared control, every edge in the cluster is slashed. The quartz rule is path-disjointness: clones paid from one treasury cannot assemble three independent neighborhoods, so manufactured votes require fresh funding trails and fresh bonds, not just new keys.
